**Yes, but only some models, and they aren't a perfect substitute for a dedicated UPS.**

**What to look for**
- **Documented UPS/EPS mode with automatic switchover.** Anker says a basic power station may keep appliances running but still interrupt a computer during an outage ([Anker](https://www.ankersolix.com/blogs/portable-power-station/can-a-portable-power-station-be-used-as-a-ups)).
- **A fast, published transfer time.** EcoFlow says many units advertised as "UPS" take 20-30 ms to switch and recommends under 10 ms for computers ([EcoFlow](https://www.ecoflow.com/us/blog/use-portable-power-station-as-ups-power-supply)). That is EcoFlow's own pitch, so treat the damage claims with some skepticism.
- **Pure sine wave output** and enough continuous wattage for your whole setup.
- **Safe continuous pass-through use** if it will stay plugged in 24/7. Check the manual.

**Caveats**
- Even 10 ms is not the 0 ms of an online double-conversion UPS. Anker says to check your device's manual, and if it requires 0 ms, use an online UPS instead ([Anker](https://www.ankersolix.com/blogs/home-power-backup/portable-power-station-ups-home-server-nas)).
- None of the sources I found confirm that these units send a shutdown signal to your computer. Some EcoFlow models mention UPS-HID support in their FAQ, but check this before relying on automatic shutdown.
- Test it by unplugging the unit from the wall while your computer is running (save your work first).

**Models with published switchover times**
- **Anker SOLIX S2000:** 2,010 Wh, 1,500 W pure sine wave, 10 ms UPS switchover, about $699.99 after coupon. [Anker's guide](https://www.ankersolix.com/blogs/portable-power-station/can-a-portable-power-station-be-used-as-a-ups) features it.
- **EcoFlow RIVER 3 Plus:** 600 W output, under 10 ms switchover, a good fit for a desktop plus a few peripherals ([EcoFlow](https://www.ecoflow.com/us/blog/use-portable-power-station-as-ups-power-supply)).
- **BLUETTI Elite 200 V2:** 2,073.6 Wh, 2,600 W, ≤15 ms switchover, $899 or $854.05 with code AFF5OFF. [Buy at BLUETTI](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-200-v2). This is an affiliate link, so the merchant pays a commission at no cost to you. Its [product page](https://dealectric.com/bluetti-elite-200-v2) lists the specs.

**Runtime estimate:** hours ≈ Wh × 0.85 ÷ load in watts. A 2,000 Wh unit running a 150 W desktop and monitor gives roughly 11 hours in ideal conditions. Real runtime will be shorter.

If you tell me your computer's wattage and whether you need automatic shutdown, I can narrow this down.
